description: Short display names for segmenter training runs (checkpoints/segmenter/runs/<run dir>), used by scripts/plot_segmenter_history.py. The name says the labeling round and the training labels: r1 = first bootstrap-and-refine round (Sept 3-4, 2026), r2 = after labeling round 2 with the bootstrap labels retired (Sept 5, 2026); boot/hand/mixed = training label source; the number is the count of training labels. Suffixes: -warm started from the promoted checkpoint instead of ImageNet, -iou selected checkpoints on validation IoU, -loss selected on validation loss without the plateau schedule. 'headline' lists the models drawn in colour in every figure, oldest first; the last entry is the newest model and the one before it is its reference.
